name: careplus-monorepo
description: CarePlus HMS — frontend (Next.js) + backend (Express REST API) monorepo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @careplus/backend" "npm run dev -w @careplus/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @careplus/backend && npm run build -w @careplus/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @careplus/backend && npm run typecheck -w @careplus/frontend
